## Transcription factor activity (CollecTRI + ULM)

```{r tf-intro, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$decoupler_out)}
cat("\n\nTranscription-factor (TF) activities inferred with ",
    "[`decoupleR`](https://bioconductor.org/packages/decoupleR/) using the ",
    "**CollecTRI** prior-knowledge network and the **Univariate Linear Model (ULM)** ",
    "method, following the bulk RNA-seq TF activity vignette. Organism for CollecTRI: **",
    params$decoupler_out$org, "**.\n\n",
    "Sample-level scores use VST-normalized expression; contrast-level scores use ",
    "each comparison's DESeq2 Wald `stat` as the gene-level statistic.\n\n", sep = "")
deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Key functions used for TF activity inference:",
  "decoupleR::get_collectri(organism = \"human\", split_complexes = FALSE)",
  "DESeq2::vst(dds, blind = TRUE)                  # sample-level expression matrix",
  "decoupleR::run_ulm(mat, net, .source = \"source\", .target = \"target\", .mor = \"mor\")",
  "# contrast-level: mat = matrix(res$stat, dimnames = list(genes, \"stat\"))"
)
```

```{r tf-missing, results='asis', eval=is.null(params$decoupler_out)}
cat("\n\nTF activity analysis was not run for this report ",
    "(`run_decoupler = FALSE` or `decoupler_out = NULL`).\n\n")
```

### Sample-level TF activities

```{r tf-sample-heat, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$decoupler_out$sample_heatmap)}
n_heat <- params$decoupler_out$n_tfs_heatmap
if (is.null(n_heat)) n_heat <- params$decoupler_out$n_tfs
cat("\n\nTop **", n_heat,
    "** most variable TFs across samples (rows = samples, columns = TFs; ",
    "scores scaled per sample). Dark blue = inactive, red = active.\n\n", sep = "")

hm <- params$decoupler_out$sample_heatmap
gt <- hm$gtable
native_w <- min(grid::convertWidth(sum(gt$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE), 10)
native_h <- min(grid::convertHeight(sum(gt$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE), 10)
# Shrink display footprint by 50% vs original, then widen heatmap by 25%.
disp_w <- 0.5 * min(native_w, 6.5) * 1.25
disp_h <- 0.5 * min(native_h, 5)
dpi <- 150
pixelratio <- dpi / 72
css_w <- as.integer(round(native_w * 72))
css_h <- as.integer(round(native_h * 72))
display_w <- as.integer(round(disp_w * dpi))
display_h <- as.integer(round(disp_h * dpi))
img <- htmltools::plotTag({
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(gt)
}, alt = "tf_sample_heatmap", width = css_w, height = css_h, pixelratio = pixelratio,
   suppressSize = "xy",
   attribs = list(
     width = display_w, height = display_h,
     style = sprintf("max-width: none !important; width: %dpx; height: %dpx;", display_w, display_h)
   ))
buttons <- list(
  deseq2reports::download_grid_plot_button(hm, filename = "ulm_sample_tf_heatmap",
                                           width = 0.5 * native_w, height = 0.5 * native_h),
  deseq2reports::download_table_button(params$decoupler_out$sample_acts,
                                       filename = "ulm_sample_activities")
)
deseq2reports::emit_widget(deseq2reports::wrap_with_corner_button(img, buttons))
```

```{r tf-helpers, include=FALSE}
emit_tf_contrast <- function(comp, bp, acts, n_tfs) {
  cat("\n\nULM scores from DESeq2 Wald statistics for this contrast. ",
      "Top **", n_tfs,
      "** TFs by signed rank (most activated and most deactivated).\n\n", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(bp)) {
    deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
      bp, filename = paste0(comp, "_ulm_tf_barplot"),
      width = 3.5, height = 1.9, dpi = 150
    )
  }
  if (!is.null(acts) && nrow(acts) > 0) {
    show <- acts[order(acts$p_value), , drop = FALSE]
    btn <- deseq2reports::download_table_button(acts, filename = paste0(comp, "_ulm_tf_activities"))
    deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
      deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(show, page_length = 15), btn
    )
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}

specs <- NULL
if (!is.null(params$diffexp_out)) {
  specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
  if (is.null(specs) && !is.null(params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts)) {
    comps <- names(params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts)
    specs <- data.frame(
      label = comps,
      class = "single",
      type = deseq2reports::classify_comparison_type(comps),
      stratum_var = NA_character_,
      stratum_level = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}
if (!is.null(specs) && !is.null(params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts)) {
  specs <- specs[specs$label %in% names(params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts), , drop = FALSE]
}
two_factor <- !is.null(specs) && any(specs$class %in% c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction"))
```

### Contrast-level TF activities

```{r tf-contrast-single, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$decoupler_out) && length(params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts) > 0 && !two_factor}
tf_pairwise <- specs$label[specs$type == "pairwise"]
tf_one_vs_all <- specs$label[specs$type == "one_vs_all"]
n_tfs <- params$decoupler_out$n_tfs

cat("\n\n#### Pairwise {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(tf_pairwise) > 0) {
  for (comp in tf_pairwise) {
    cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_tf_contrast(comp,
                     params$decoupler_out$contrast_barplots[[comp]],
                     params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
                     n_tfs)
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo pairwise comparisons.\n\n")
}

cat("\n\n#### One vs. all {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(tf_one_vs_all) > 0) {
  for (comp in tf_one_vs_all) {
    cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_tf_contrast(comp,
                     params$decoupler_out$contrast_barplots[[comp]],
                     params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
                     n_tfs)
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo one-vs-all comparisons.\n\n")
}
```

```{r tf-contrast-two-factor, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$decoupler_out) && length(params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts) > 0 && two_factor}
var <- params$var
n_tfs <- params$decoupler_out$n_tfs
for (cls in c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction")) {
  sub <- specs[specs$class == cls, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  title <- deseq2reports::contrast_class_title(cls, var)
  cat("\n\n#### ", title, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")

  if (identical(cls, "interaction")) {
    for (comp in sub$label) {
      cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
      emit_tf_contrast(comp,
                       params$decoupler_out$contrast_barplots[[comp]],
                       params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
                       n_tfs)
    }
    next
  }

  strata <- unique(sub$stratum_level)
  for (st in strata) {
    cat("\n\n##### ", st, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
    st_sub <- sub[sub$stratum_level == st, , drop = FALSE]
    ordered <- c(st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "pairwise"],
                 st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "one_vs_all"])
    for (comp in ordered) {
      cat("\n\n###### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
      emit_tf_contrast(comp,
                       params$decoupler_out$contrast_barplots[[comp]],
                       params$decoupler_out$contrast_acts[[comp]],
                       n_tfs)
    }
  }
}
```
